system.description:
SHAMAN SOUL UTILITY WARDING
Shaman Specialist Spell
Cast 1 AP (somatic)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 willing creature
Duration 1 minute

A protective spirit folds its presence around the target.
The target gains Resistance to essence damage.
In addition, the first time during the duration that the target would gain Soul Drain, reduce the amount gained by 5, to a minimum of 0. The Soul Drain protection is then expended, although the target retains its Resistance to essence damage for the remainder of the spell.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Affect one additional willing creature.
+4 PP: The Soul Drain protection can activate twice before being expended.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
